units.source_en: Other Houses Great And Small HOUSE ARRYN The Arryns are descended from the Kings of Mountain and Vale, one of the oldest and purest lines of Andal nobility.
House Arryn has taken no part in the War of the Five Kings, holding back its strength to protect the Vale of Arryn.
The Arryn sigil is the moon-and-falcon, white, upon a sky-blue field.
